Roger Rabbit.name: Roger Rabbit
Roger Rabbit.summary: Roger Rabbit is the first game in the Crazy Castle series, known in the West as Bugs Bunny's Crazy Castle. The Roger Rabbit version was developed for the Famicom Disk System and released only in Japan.
